name: leadforge-ai
description: LeadForge-AI — keyword-driven Google Maps lead scraper with website enrichment, live dashboard and sheet-wise export.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start
